mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and corporate profit expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based contraction in the real economy, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline by at least 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), higher interest rates increase the cost of capital and reduce corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential investment (RSAFS) indicates strong housing market activity that supports consumer wealth and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO falls < -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a disinflationary monetary policy that reduces the risk of stagflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls by at least 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), low unemployment supports strong consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%.
